description: Request a time-boxed rental of an available robot. Select an offered access_type or omit it for the primary rental arrangement. Personnel-operated and equipment-only rentals require empty granted_permissions and mint no control token. Remote controls require configured integration and permitted scope; remote_teleoperation uses supervisory (command) mode unless you pass control_mode teleop and the listing offers it. The window must fit the listing rental_availability; for on_request listings, inquire first and pass the promise_id of an accepted window. The request waits for operator approval (REQUESTED); poll get_lease, then activate once CONFIRMED.

agreed_price.description: Payment isn't handled through the API (pricing and payouts: hello@getbody.md): must be null or omitted (else 400 payment_arranged_by_getbody).

body_kind.description: Which of the listing's bodies to lease; required when it offers both.

currency.description: Payments are not enabled yet: must be null or omitted.

promise_id.description: Redeem a promise of lease (from accept_inquiry): the window must lie within the promised window.

name: request_lease
title: Request a robot lease
